items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: He played with Earl Dan on there for a couple of years. Earl Dan had the band on for two or three years.

ctx.x: Well, let's see. Norman Basin is still alive. Johnny Dodge, Fountain Blue, Fountain Blue. No. It's just been, uh. Johnny Dodge, uh, Lorenzo. Could Lorenzo Tio have played on the boat? I'm trying to remember. No.

No, not Tio. Earl Fink. But, no. This man really won't be, uh. Is it that? Was it with Faye? Or with P-ron? No, he played with P-ron. He played with P-ron. Oh, okay. Well, I could find that, uh. Well, no, then, uh, that was on the color side. Now, on the white side, the, uh, the white color side a couple of years ago. He played with Earl Dan on there for a couple of years. Earl Dan had the band on for two or three years.
Oh, uh, Blue was on. Fasola, Fasola, yeah. Blue Pristotnik and Irving Fasola were both here.
